description.en: Pure handcrafted creations combining exotic Merbau hardwood, natural amber Damar resin, and selected fine timbers. From master chess sets to organic artisan beads and wearable accessories.
description.id: Kerajinan murni buatan tangan yang memadukan kayu keras Merbau eksotis, resin Damar amber alami, dan kayu pilihan terbaik. Dari papan catur master hingga manik-manik organik dan aksesori eksklusif.

title.en: Apex Merbau x Damar Chess Set
title.id: Set Catur Merbau x Damar Apex

description.en: Hand-carved premium Merbau hardwood embedded with translucent glowing Damar resin rivers. Complete with precision weighted wooden chess pieces.
description.id: Papan kayu Merbau premium ukiran tangan yang disematkan aliran resin Damar amber bercahaya. Lengkap dengan set bidak kayu berbobot presisi.

description.en: Hand-turned and polished artisan beads crafted from Merbau grain, Damar amber fusion, and rare forest woods. Perfect for custom bracelets, necklaces, and pendants.
description.id: Manik-manik buatan tangan yang dibubut dan dipoles dari kayu Merbau, fusi resin Damar amber, dan kayu hutan langka. Sangat cocok untuk gelang, kalung, dan liontin kustom.

description.en: Have a specific design in mind? We handcraft custom EDC items, keychains, coasters, and decorative display pieces tailored from high-grade timber.
description.id: Punya ide atau desain impian? Kami melayani pembuatan kriya kustom seperti item EDC, gantungan kunci, coaster, hingga hiasan dekoratif dari kayu premium.

description.en: Experience the raw creation process—from turning beads on the lathe to pouring liquid Damar resin and hand-polishing timber.
description.id: Saksikan langsung proses pembuatan—mulai dari membubut manik kayu, penuangan resin Damar cair, hingga pemolesan manual.

description.en: Demonstrating precision hand-turning of Merbau wood and Damar resin into smooth, glossy artisan beads.
description.id: Demonstrasi pembubutan tangan presisi kayu Merbau dan resin Damar menjadi manik-manik halus dan berkilau.

description.en: Behind the scenes: infusing organic Damar amber resin with natural hardwood and fine sanding to a glass-like finish.
description.id: Di balik layar: memadukan resin Damar amber alami dengan kayu keras dan pengampelasan halus hingga bening mengkilap.

description.en: Crafted deep within the peaceful atmosphere of our forest studio, every creation—whether a full chess board or a single hand-carved bead—bridges pure organic materials with dedicated artisan passion. No two pieces are ever identical; every grain pattern of Merbau timber and every amber swirl of Damar resin holds its own unique piece of nature.
description.id: Dibuat di tengah ketenangan studio hutan kami, setiap karya—baik papan catur penuh maupun sebutir manik ukiran tangan—menjembatani bahan organik murni dengan dedikasi kriya tingkat tinggi. Tidak ada dua karya yang identik; setiap serat kayu Merbau dan pusaran amber resin Damar menyimpan keunikan alamnya sendiri.
